reason: Fixations are short to medium (0.17–0.5s) with frequent small saccades within a compact region around screen center, and occasional modest vertical shifts, resembling the mixed, exploratory scanning of web pages more than the highly horizontal, line-based pattern of READ or the top/bottom-biased regions of WRITE and SEARCH.
